thesis: Neither carries a directional valuation case: the low vendor multiple and core-profit headline are uncompleted normalisation tasks. Thin headline margin cannot determine segment cash returns, and missing leverage cannot be treated as distress. The profitable base warrants research while buying value remains unestablished.
strongest_counterexample: FY26 net profit RM1.76bn and the separate higher-core-profit headline RM1.55bn offer a potentially substantive operating-value case at a vendor trailing reference of 9.58x.
invalidation_conditions: A dated segment reconciliation establishes positive comparable core-profit growth and CFO less investment above zero with funded debt obligations, resolving the normalisation and cash gates.
A subsequent comparable annual core-profit result at or below zero would defeat the retained profitable-core thesis.
evidence_gaps: Matched prior-year revenue/core earnings, current leverage and FCF.
decisive_factors: FY26 revenue RM69.5bn and net profit RM1.76bn are observed levels, not a complete trend.
Approximately 2.53% headline ratio is not segment return.
Positive moving-average context lacks fresh volume/momentum confirmation.
